questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a phosphorus-phosphorus ($\mathrm{P-P}$) single bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$) contains a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ single bond. Its structure is $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$.

questions.stem: In the reaction of phosphorus with concentrated $\text{HNO}_3$, the oxidation state of phosphorus changes from 0 to +$x$. The value of $x$ is ________.
questions.solution:
Concentrated nitric acid oxidizes phosphorus ($\text{P}_4$) to orthophosphoric acid ($\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$):
$\text{P}_4 + 20\text{HNO}_3 \rightarrow 4\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4 + 20\text{NO}_2 + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$
In $\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4$, the oxidation state of phosphorus is +5.
Thus, $x = 5$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ single bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$, which has the structure $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$ containing a direct $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ bond. Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$) contains a $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{P}$ bond.

questions.stem: The number of bridged oxygen atoms present in $\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ is _______.
questions.solution:
The structure of $\text{P}_4\text{O}_{10}$ is based on a tetrahedron of phosphorus atoms.
There are 6 edge-bridging P-O-P oxygen atoms.
Additionally, there are 4 terminal P=O double bonds.
Thus, the number of bridged oxygen atoms is 6.
